reference.text: Also, that in Henry VIIIth’s time, a certain cook of the court obtained a handsome reward for inventing an admirable sauce to be eaten with barbacued porpoises, which, you remember, are a species of whale.

underlines.text: which would be as fine eating as the buffalo’s

reference.text: Porpoises, indeed, are to this day considered fine eating.

underlines.text: eat it too by its own light

reference.text: That mortal man should feed upon the creature that feeds his lamp, and, like Stubb, eat him by his own light, as you may say; this seems so outlandish a thing that one must needs go a little into the history and philosophy of it.
